scope: Export generation, download, cancellation, release, expiry and quota eviction retain cleanup ownership until deletion succeeds; retries protect transfer outcomes and original source bytes

before.sourceState: Unchanged b.3.8 release export-service.mjs; new tests run before production edits
before.reproduction: All nine cases failed on their intended outcome assertions: HTTP retry leaves ZIP, concurrent release reports success early, expiry never retries, cleanup replaces completed/interrupted/cancelled/I/O outcomes, and quota eviction permits accumulation. The same test file passed after the fix.

application.skipReason: Both native archive interoperability and native registry-contract groups require VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; this audit changes Node cleanup only, and keeps the actual native verification from release b.3.8.

testEnvironment: Actual production export planning, ZIP writer, API route and HTTP streaming operate on temporary v3 projects in isolated Node processes. Exact staging-directory EBUSY and final-stat EIO faults are injected; short TTLs exercise automatic recovery. Each new case compares workspace.json, documents (including BOM/CRLF), templates, registry metadata and assets byte for byte. HTTP download compares all ZIP bytes. This is not a Windows native file-lock experiment.
